name: RW04-B3 Inventory reservation
description: RW04-B3 (RW04 real-world test). Loads the stock into the QA ledger database, reserves each accepted order line in the store with the stock record's version (re-reading and retrying on a 409 conflict) and in the ledger the same way, backorders what is not in stock, works out split shipments, releases the reservation of a cancelled test order, reconciles ledger and store stock, checks the bounds, emits an event to Kafka and checkpoints the queue item.

args.text: What this agent does: Loads the stock into the QA ledger database, reserves each accepted order line in the store with the stock record's version (re-reading and retrying on a 409 conflict) and in the ledger the same way, backorders what is not in stock, works out split shipments, releases the reservation of a cancelled test order, reconciles ledger and store stock, checks the bounds, emits an event to Kafka and checkpoints the queue item. It works through 10 accepted orders (the accepted ones) and writes its results to the run's output folder.
